title: Public Health Protection Notice (Food) (Application of Changes to the Annex to European Union Directives) (Regulation 231/2012 - Specifications of Food Additives Listed in Annexes II and III to Regulation No. 1333/2008), 5786-2026
description:
Commission Regulation (EU) No. 231/2012 of 9 March 2012 determines specifications for food additives listed in Annexes II and III to Regulation No. 1333/2008 of the European Commission and of the Council (hereinafter - Regulation 231/2012) was adopted in Israel as part of Amendment No. 10 to the Public Health Protection (Food) Law, 5776-2015 (hereinafter - the Law/Food Law), and appears in Item 9 of Appendix II A to the Law. Regulation 231/2012 was fully implemented, with the expansion listed in Column C of Item 9 of Appendix II A to the Law, in addition to the exceptions as stated in Section 3A(a1) to (a5) of the Law.

 

To date, notices have been published in the Official Gazette (Reshumot) that included changes that took place in the European Union in Regulation 231/2012, and were applied in Israel (updates), with the most recent being published on 21 April 2026, being the Public Health Protection Notice (Food) (Application of Changes to the Annex to the European Union Directives) (Regulation 231/2012 - Specifications of Food Additives Listed in Annexes II and III to Regulation No. 1333/2008) (No. 2)(Amendment), 5786-2026, signed by the Director of the National Food Service in the Ministry of Health, as she was then described. The latest updated consolidated version, adopted and published on the Food Service website after the publication of the aforementioned notice, is the version valid in European legislation as it stood on 27 October 2025.

 

It is now proposed to apply in Israel the changes to the Annex to Regulation 231/2012 that will be applied in the European Union, without modifications, conditions, exceptions, or expansions, while integrating them into the text of Regulation 231/2012 as adopted today. The essence of the changes is in the specifications of food additives. It is clarified that the expansion that appears in column C of item 9 in Appendix II A will continue to apply to the changes proposed to be implemented in Israel. The changes included in this proposed amendment combine the following EU Regulations amending various Annexes of Regulation (EC) No. 231/2012:
 

1. COMMISSION REGULATION (EU) 2024/2597 of 4 October 2024 amending Annex II to Regulation (EC) No 1333/2008 of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards the use of sorbic acid (E 200) and potassium sorbate (E 202) and the Annex to Commission Regulation (EU) No 231/2012 as regards the specifications for sorbic acid (E 200), potassium sorbate (E 202) and propyl gallate (E 310)

  1. In the entry concerning the substance "Sorbic acid (E 200)": (a) Replacement of the specification relating to description; (b) Replacement of the specification relating to purity.
  2. In the entry concerning the substance "Potassium sorbate (E 202)": (a) Replacement of the specification relating to description; (b) Replacement of the specification relating to purity.
  3. In the entry concerning the substance "Propyl gallate (E 310)": (a) Replacement of the specification relating to definition; (b) Replacement of the specification relating to purity.

 

2. Commission Regulation (EU) 2025/652 of 2 April 2025 amending Regulation (EC) No 1333/2008 of the European Parliament and the Council and Commission Regulation (EU) No 231/2012 as regards the use of Steviol glycosides produced by fermentation using Yarrowia lipolytica

  • Addition of the entry concerning the substance E 960b(i) Rebaudioside M produced by fermentation using Yarrowia lipolytica.

 

3. Commission Regulation (EU) 2025/666 of 4 April 2025 amending Annex II and Annex III to Regulation (EC) No 1333/2008 of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards the use of sodium carboxy methyl cellulose, cellulose gum (E 466) and the Annex to Commission Regulation (EU) No 231/2012 as regards specifications for cellulose (E 460), methyl cellulose (E 461), ethyl cellulose (E 462), hydroxypropyl cellulose (E 463), hydroxypropyl methyl cellulose (E 464), ethyl methyl cellulose (E 465), sodium carboxy methyl cellulose, cellulose gum (E 466), cross-linked sodium carboxy methyl cellulose, cross linked cellulose gum (E 468) and enzymatically hydrolysed carboxy methyl cellulose (E 469)

  1.  In the entry concerning the substance E 460(i) Microcrystalline cellulose, Cellulose gel: (a) Addition of a specification; (b) Replacement of the specification relating to purity.
  2. In the entry concerning the substance E 460(ii) Powdered cellulose: (a) Addition of a specification; (b) Replacement of the specification relating to purity.
  3. In the entry concerning the substance E 461 Methyl cellulose: (a) Addition of a specification; (b) Replacement of the specification relating to EINECS; (c) Replacement of the specification relating to identification; (d) Replacement of the specification relating to purity.
  4. In the entry concerning the substance E 462 Ethyl cellulose: (a) Addition of a specification; (b) Replacement of the specification relating to EINECS; (c) Replacement of the specification relating to pH; (d) Replacement of the specification relating to purity.
  5. In the entry concerning the substance E 463 Hydroxypropyl cellulose: (a) Addition of a specification; (b) Replacement of the specification relating to EINECS; (c) Replacement of the specification relating to identification; (d) Replacement of the specification relating to purity.
  6. In the entry concerning the substance E 463a Low-substituted hydroxypropyl cellulose (L-HPC): (a) Replacement of the specification relating to EINECS number; (b) Replacement of the specification relating to pH; (c) Replacement of the specification relating to purity.
  7. In the entry concerning the substance E 464 Hydroxypropyl methyl cellulose: (a) Addition of a specification; (b) Replacement of the specification relating to EINECS; (c) Replacement of the specification relating to identification; (d) Replacement of the specification relating to purity.
  8. In the entry concerning the substance E 465 Ethyl methyl cellulose: (a) Addition of a specification; (b) Replacement of the specification relating to identification; (c) Replacement of the specification relating to purity.
  9. In the entry concerning the substance E 466 Sodium carboxymethyl cellulose, Cellulose gum: (a) Addition of a specification; (b) Replacement of the specification relating to EINECS; (c) Replacement of the specification relating to identification; (d) Replacement of the specification relating to purity.
  10. In the entry concerning the substance E 468 Cross-linked sodium carboxymethyl cellulose, Cross-linked cellulose gum: (a) Addition of a specification; (b) Replacement of the specification relating to EINECS; (c) Replacement of the specification relating to pH; (d) Replacement of the specification relating to purity.
  11. In the entry concerning the substance E 469 Enzymatically hydrolysed carboxymethylcellulose, Enzymatically hydrolysed cellulose gum: (a) Replacement of the specification relating to identification; (b) Replacement of the specification relating to purity.


4. Commission Regulation (EU) 2025/2084 of 17 October 2025 amending Regulation (EC) No 1333/2008 of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards the use of quillaia extract (E 999) and Commission Regulation (EU) No 231/2012 as regards the specifications for quillaia extract (E 999)

  • In the Annex to the Regulation – Replacement of the entry for quillaia extract (E 999).

 

5. Commission Regulation (EU) 2026/189 of 28 January 2026 amending Regulation (EC) No 1333/2008 of the European Parliament and the Council and Commission Regulation (EU) No 231/2012 as regards the use of shellac (E 904) in food for special medical purposes in tablet and coated tablet forms

  • In Annex II to the Regulation, in the entry concerning the substance E 904 –
  1. Replacement of the specification relating to definition.
  2. Replacement of the specification relating to description.
  3. Replacement of the specification relating to wax content.

 

6. Commission Regulation (EU) 2026/196 of 28 January 2026 amending Regulation (EC) No 1333/2008 of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards the use of carrageenan (E 407), locust bean gum (E 410), guar gum (E 412), gum arabic (acacia gum) (E 414), xanthan gum (E 415), pectins (E 440) and starch sodium octenyl succinate (E 1450) and Commission Regulation (EU) No 231/2012 as regards specifications for locust bean gum (E 410), guar gum (E 412), gum arabic (acacia gum) (E 414), xanthan gum (E 415), pectins (E 440) and starch sodium octenyl succinate (E 1450)

  • In Annex II to the Regulation –
  1. Replacement of the entry concerning Locust bean gum (E 410).
  2. Replacement of the entry concerning Guar gum (E 412).
  3. Replacement of the entry concerning Gum arabic (Acacia gum) (E 414).
  4. Replacement of the entry concerning Xanthan gum (E 415).
  5. Replacement of the entry concerning Pectin (E 440(i)).
  6. Replacement of the entry concerning Amidated pectin (E 440(ii))
  7. Replacement of the entry concerning Starch sodium octenyl succinate (E 1450).

title: Public Health Protection Notice (Food) (Application of Changes to the Annex to European Union Directives) (Regulation 1333/2008 - Food Additives), 5786-2026
description:
Commission Regulation (EC) No. 1333/2008 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 16 December 2008 regarding food additives was adopted in Israel as part of Amendment No. 10 to the Public Health Protection (Food) Law, 5776-2015 (hereinafter - the Law/Food Law), and appears in Item 8 of Appendix II A to the Law. Regulation 1333/2008 was applied in full, in addition to the exceptions as stated in Section 3A(a1) to (a5) of the Law.

 

To date, notices have been published in the Official Gazette (Reshumot) that included changes that took place in the European Union in Regulation 1333/2008, and which were applied in Israel (updates), with the most recent being published on 21 April 2026, being the Public Health Protection (Food) Notice (Application of Changes in the Annex to the European Union Directives) (Regulation 1333/2008 - Food Additives) (No. 2)(Amendment No. 2), 5776-2026, signed by the director of Health Regulation Directorate (Food, Alcoholic Beverages and Cosmetics) at the Ministry of Health. The latest updated consolidated version, adopted and published on the Food Service website following the publication of the aforementioned notice, is the version valid in European legislation as as it stood on 9 November 2025.

 

It is now proposed to apply in Israel the change in the Annex to Regulation 1333/2008 that applied in the European Union, without modifications, conditions, exceptions, or expansions, while integrating them into the text of Regulation 1333/2008, as adopted today. The essence of the change is a change in the conditions of use of various food additives. The changes included in this proposed amendment combine the following EU Regulations amending various Annexes of Regulation (EC) No. 1333/2008:
 

1. COMMISSION REGULATION (EU) 2024/1451 of 24 May 2024 amending Annex II and Annex III to Regulation (EC) No 1333/2008 of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards the food additives tartaric acid (L(+)-) (E 334), sodium tartrates (E 335), potassium tartrates (E 336), sodium potassium tartrate (E 337) and calcium tartrate (E 354)

  • In Annex II –
  1. In Part C – (1) Deletion of the entries in sub-paragraph 1, concerning the food additives tartaric acid (L(+)-) E 334, sodium tartrates E 335, potassium tartrates E 336, sodium potassium tartrate E 337, and calcium tartrate E 354; (2) Addition of a sub-paragraph in sub-paragraph 5: "11. 2) E 334–337 and E 354 – tartaric acid – tartrates".
  2. In Part E – 41 amendments concerning entries of various food additives in various food categories
  • In Annex III – Five amendments concerning entries of various food additives in various parts of this Annex. 

 

2. COMMISSION REGULATION (EU) 2024/2597 of 4 October 2024 amending Annex II to Regulation (EC) No 1333/2008 of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards the use of sorbic acid (E 200) and potassium sorbate (E 202) and the Annex to Commission Regulation (EU) No 231/2012 as regards the specifications for sorbic acid (E 200), potassium sorbate (E 202) and propyl gallate (E 310)

  • In Annex II, in Part E – In food category No. 16 "Desserts excluding products covered by categories 1, 3 and 4" – Replacement of the entry concerning the use of sorbic acid – potassium sorbate (E 200–202) in frugtgrød, rote Grütze and pasha at a level of 1,000 mg/kg.

 

3. COMMISSION REGULATION (EU) 2024/2608 of 7 October 2024 amending Annex II to Regulation (EC) No 1333/2008 of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards the use of powdered cellulose (E 460(ii)) and glucono-delta-lactone (E 575) in unripened soft spreadable cheese products

  • In Annex II, in Part E – Amendment to food category 01.7.6 "Cheese products (excluding products covered by category 16)":
  1. Replacement of the entry concerning powdered cellulose (E 460)
  2. Replacement of the entry concerning glucono-delta-lactone (E 575)

 

4. Commission Regulation (EU) 2025/651 of 2 April 2025 amending Regulation (EC) No 1333/2008 as regards the use of mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids (E 471) and carnauba wax (E 903) as glazing agents on certain fresh fruit and cassavas and of lecithins (E 322) and fatty acids (E 570) as carriers in glazing agents on cassavas

  • In Annex II, in Part E, concerning food category 04.1.1 (Fresh fruit and vegetables, whole) –
  1. Replacement of the entry concerning mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids (E 471);
  2. Replacement of the entry concerning carnauba wax (E 903).
  • In Annex III, in Part 1 (Carriers in food additives) – Addition of the entry concerning lecithins (E 322) and fatty acids (E 570).

 

5. Commission Regulation (EU) 2025/652 of 2 April 2025 amending Regulation (EC) No 1333/2008 of the European Parliament and the Council and Commission Regulation (EU) No 231/2012 as regards the use of Steviol glycosides produced by fermentation using Yarrowia lipolytica

  • In Annex II –
  1. In Part B, in sub-paragraph 2 (Sweeteners) – Addition of an entry concerning E 960b (Steviol glycosides from fermentation).
  2. In Part C, in sub-paragraph 5 (Other food additives that may be regulated jointly) – Replacement of entry 11.2 concerning Steviol glycosides (E 960a–960d).

 

6. Commission Regulation (EU) 2025/666 of 4 April 2025 amending Annex II and Annex III to Regulation (EC) No 1333/2008 of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards the use of sodium carboxy methyl cellulose, cellulose gum (E 466) and the Annex to Commission Regulation (EU) No 231/2012 as regards specifications for cellulose (E 460), methyl cellulose (E 461), ethyl cellulose (E 462), hydroxypropyl cellulose (E 463), hydroxypropyl methyl cellulose (E 464), ethyl methyl cellulose (E 465), sodium carboxy methyl cellulose, cellulose gum (E 466), cross-linked sodium carboxy methyl cellulose, cross linked cellulose gum (E 468) and enzymatically hydrolysed carboxy methyl cellulose (E 469)

  • In Annex II, in Part E –
  1. In food category 13.1.5.1 (Dietary foods for special medical purposes for infants and special formulae for infants) – Deletion of the entry concerning food additive E 466 (sodium carboxymethyl cellulose, cellulose gum);
  2. In food category 13.1.5.2 (Dietary foods for special medical purposes for infants and young children as defined in Directive 1999/21/EC) – Deletion of the entry concerning food additive E 466 (sodium carboxymethyl cellulose, cellulose gum)
  • In Annex III, in Part 5, in Section B thereof – Deletion of the entry concerning food additive E 466 (sodium carboxymethyl cellulose, cellulose gum).

 

7. Commission Regulation (EU) 2025/1150 of 11 June 2025 amending Annex III to Regulation (EC) No 1333/2008 of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards the use of sodium ascorbate (E 301) in vitamin A preparations intended for infant formula and follow-on formula

  • In Annex III, in Part 5, in Section B thereof – Replacement of the entry concerning food additive E 301 (sodium ascorbate).

 

8. Commission Regulation (EU) 2025/1337 of 10 July 2025 amending Annex III to Regulation (EC) No 1333/2008 of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards the use of polyvinylpolypyrrolidone (E 1202) as a carrier in colour tablets for the decorative colouring of poultry eggshells

  • In Annex III, in Part 1 (Carriers in food additives) – Addition of an entry concerning polyvinylpolypyrrolidone (E 1202).


9. Commission Regulation (EU) 2025/2058 of 14 October 2025 amending Annexes II and III and correcting Annex II to Regulation (EC) No 1333/2008 of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards foods intended for particular nutritional uses

  • In Annex II –
  1. In Part A – (1) Table 1, replacement of entry 12. (2) Table 2, replacement of entry 30.
  2. In Part D – (1) Addition of entry 01.10. (2) Replacement of the entries concerning category 13 and its subcategories. (3) Replacement of the entry concerning category 18.
  3. In Part E – (1) Replacement of the entries concerning category 0, E 290, E 938, E 939, E 941, E 942, E 948, E 949; (2) Addition of entry 01.10, edible caseinates; (3) Replacement of entry 06.4.2 (Dried pasta); (4) Replacement of the title of category 13; (5) Replacement of entry 13.1 (Foods for infants and young children); (6) Replacement of the title of category 13.1.1.; (7) Replacement of footnote 15 to categories 13.1.1 and 13.1.2; (8) Replacement of footnote 43 to categories 13.1.1 and 13.1.2; (9) Replacement of footnote 44 to categories 13.1.1 and 13.1.2; (10) Replacement of the title of category 13.1.2. (11) Replacement of the title of category 13.1.3.;(12) Deletion of the entry of category 13.1.4; (13) Replacement of the title of category 13.1.5; (14) Replacement of the title of category 13.1.5.1; (15) Replacement of the title of category 13.1.5.2; (16) Replacement of the title of category 13.2; (17) Replacement of the title of category 13.3; (18) Deletion of the entry of category 13.4; (19) Replacement of the entry of category 18 and addition of two new entries concerning categories 18.1 and 18.3.
  • In Annex III –
  1. Replacement of the definition in paragraph 1 of 'nutritional substances'.
  2. In Part 5 – (1) Part A, replacement of the introductory text; (2) Part B, replacement of the introductory text; (3) Part B, replacement of the table.
  • In Annex II
  1. In Part E – (1) Replacement of the entry in category 13.2 concerning the value Advantame; (2) Replacement of the entry in category 13.3 concerning the value Advantame.

 

10. Commission Regulation (EU) 2025/2060 of 14 October 2025 amending Regulation (EC) No 1333/2008 of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards the use of sorbic acid (E 200) and potassium sorbate (E 202) in non-heat-treated plant-based mousses

  • In Annex II, in Part E – Addition of an entry in food category 16, concerning sorbic acid – potassium sorbate (E 200–202).


11. Commission Regulation (EU) 2025/2084 of 17 October 2025 amending Regulation (EC) No 1333/2008 of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards the use of quillaia extract (E 999) and Commission Regulation (EU) No 231/2012 as regards the specifications for quillaia extract (E 999)

  • In Annex II, in Part E –
  1. Replacement of the entry of category 14.1.4 concerning E 999, quillaia extract.
  2. Replacement of the entry of category 14.2.3 concerning E 999, quillaia extract.
  3. Addition of an entry in category 17.1 concerning E 999, quillaia extract, after the second entry concerning E 969.
  4. Addition of an entry in category 17.2 concerning E 999, quillaia extract, after the second entry concerning E 969.
  • In Annex III, in Part 4 – Addition of an entry concerning E 999, quillaia extract, after the entry concerning Beeswax (E 901).

 

12. Commission Regulation (EU) 2026/189 of 28 January 2026 amending Regulation (EC) No 1333/2008 of the European Parliament and the Council and Commission Regulation (EU) No 231/2012 as regards the use of shellac (E 904) in food for special medical purposes in tablet and coated tablet forms

  • In Annex II, in Part E – Addition of an entry concerning category 13.2, E 904.

 

13. Commission Regulation (EU) 2026/196 of 28 January 2026 amending Regulation (EC) No 1333/2008 of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards the use of carrageenan (E 407), locust bean gum (E 410), guar gum (E 412), gum arabic (acacia gum) (E 414), xanthan gum (E 415), pectins (E 440) and starch sodium octenyl succinate (E 1450) and Commission Regulation (EU) No 231/2012 as regards specifications for locust bean gum (E 410), guar gum (E 412), gum arabic (acacia gum) (E 414), xanthan gum (E 415), pectins (E 440) and starch sodium octenyl succinate (E 1450)

  • In Annex II, in Part E –
  1. In food category 01.10 – (1) Replacement of the entry concerning E 407; (2) Replacement of the entry concerning E 410; (3) Replacement of the entry concerning E 412; (4) Replacement of the entry concerning E 414; (5) Replacement of the entry concerning E 415; (6) Replacement of the entry concerning E 440; (7) Deletion of footnote (21); (8) Addition of a new footnote (X) after footnote 44.
  2. In food category 13.1.1 – Deletion of the entry concerning E 412.
  3. In food category 13.1.5.1 – (1) Replacement of the first sentence; (2) Replacement of the entry concerning E 410; (3) Deletion of the entry concerning E 412; (4) Replacement of the entry concerning E 440; (5) Replacement of the entries concerning E 1450.
  4. In food category 13.1.5.2 – (1) Replacement of the first sentence; (2) Replacement of the entry concerning E 410; (3) Replacement of the entry concerning E 412; (4) Replacement of the entry concerning E 440; (5) Replacement of the entries concerning E 1450.

title: Resolución Ejecutiva No.046-2026 Regulación de ciertas sustancias de uso veterinario prohibidas y restringidas en la Republica de Nicaragua (Executive Resolution No. 046-2026 regulating certain prohibited and restricted substances for veterinary use in the Republic of Nicaragua)
description: The notified Executive Resolution establishes provisions for regulating and controlling the use and marketing of substances for veterinary use, based on on their prohibited or restricted status.It prohibits, within the national territory, the manufacture, health registration, importation, sale, marketing, transport, storage, handling, possession, and use in all aquatic and terrestrial animal species, whether individually, in combination, as raw materials, in finished veterinary medicines, or as ingredient in animal feed, of the 56 substances listed in the second operative paragraph of Executive Resolution No. 046-2026;. It also sets out specific restrictions on clenbuterol, methyl violet, nitroimidazoles, avermectins, sulfonamides (sulfa drugs), antimicrobial growth promoters or performance enhancers, methylene blue, and chlorpromazine; and includes additional provisions for farms under the Segregated Bovine Production System (SSPB), and animals and products for export.

title: Resolución Ejecutiva No.035-2026 Disposiciones para el Registro y Trazabilidad de la Especie Porcina en Nicaragua (Executive Resolution No. 035-2026 on provisions for the registration and traceability of swine in Nicaragua)
description: The notified Executive Resolution lays down mandatory administrative, technical and health provisions concerning the registration, identification and traceability of swine in Nicaragua. These provisions are mandatory for any natural or legal person, whether public or private, involved in the swine supply chain. This includes:• Pig farms (industrial, semi-industrial, family-run or backyard)• Collection centres• Genetic centres• Transporters and means of transport of swine• Marketers• Slaughterhouses, municipal abattoirs, and processing plants.The Resolution provides for registration in the Trazar-Agro traceability system and assignment of a Unique Facility Identifier (CUE); it also regulates individual or batch identification, including RFID ear tags for breeding stock and imported or exported swine.G/SPS/N/NIC/377- 2 -

This includes:• Pig farms (industrial, semi-industrial, family-run or backyard)• Collection centres• Genetic centres• Transporters and means of transport of swine• Marketers• Slaughterhouses, municipal abattoirs, and processing plants.The Resolution provides for registration in the Trazar-Agro traceability system and assignment of a Unique Facility Identifier (CUE); it also regulates individual or batch identification, including RFID ear tags for breeding stock and imported or exported swine.G/SPS/N/NIC/377- 2 -

title: Draft Decision of the Collegium of the Eurasian Economic Commission on Amendments to Decision of the Customs Union Commission of 28 May 2010 No. 299
description:
The draft Decision amends Decision of the Customs Union Commission No. 299 of 28 May 2010 "On the Application of Sanitary Measures in the Customs Union":
1) It enables granting transitional periods for the entry into force of amendments to sanitary requirements subject to the following conditions:
- the amendments cover products included in the Common List of Products (Goods) Subject to Sanitary and Epidemiological Surveillance (Control) at the Customs Border and on the Customs Territory of the Eurasian Economic Union and
- the products in question are not subject to technical regulations of the Eurasian Economic Union;
2) It also updates certain terminological references without changing the substance of the existing sanitary requirements.
productsFreeText: Products included in the Common List of Goods Subject to Sanitary and Epidemiological Surveillance (Control) at the Customs Border and on the Customs Territory of the Eurasian Economic Union, which are not subject to technical regulations of the Eurasian Economic Union (Customs Union)
objectivesFreeText: The measure establishes a general legal mechanism of transitional periods for certain amendments to the Common Sanitary Requirements to ensure smooth adaptation of economic operators, including foreign producers and exporters, to new or amended requirements and the recognition of conformity assessment documents previously issued, while maintaining the existing level of sanitary protection.

title: Turkish Food Codex Regulation on Food Flavourings and Certain Food Ingredients with Flavouring Properties for Use in And on Foods
description:
The Turkish Food Codex Regulation on Food Flavourings and Certain Food Ingredients with Flavouring Properties for Use in And on Foods, which was notified through G/SPS/N/TUR/151 (22 November 2024), was adopted and published in the Official Gazette dated 14 September 2026 and numbered 33370. 

 

The Regulation establishes provisions on food flavourings, food ingredients with flavouring properties, the source materials used in their production, their conditions of use and labelling principles, as well as production conditions for smoke flavourings. 

 

The Regulation entered into force on the date of its publication. Food business operators subject to the Regulation must comply with its provisions by 31 December 2026. Products placed on the market before 31 December 2026 may remain on the market until the end of their shelf life in accordance with the transitional provisions. Certain flavouring substances listed in the transitional provision may no longer be placed on the market, used in food production or imported as of 31 December 2026.

title: Draft Commission Implementing Regulation concerning the authorisation of anise tinctures from Pimpinella anisum L. as feed additives for certain animal species and anise essential oil from Pimpinella anisum L. as a feed additive for certain animal species and the withdrawal from the market of these feed additives for all other animal species (Text with EEA relevance)
description: Two anise tinctures and anise essential oil from Pimpinella anisum L. were initially authorised in accordance with Directive 70/524/EEC as feed additives for all animal species in the category of ‘sensory additives’ and in the functional group ‘flavouring compounds’. Applications were later submitted for the reauthorisation of these substances in accordance with article 10 of Regulation (EC) No 1831/2003. Based on the conclusions of the scientific assessments of the dossiers submitted by the applicants, conducted by the European Food Safety Authority (EFSA), it is proposed to reauthorise these substances as feed additives for certain animal species in the additive category of ‘sensory additives’ and in the functional group ‘flavouring compounds’, under certain conditions detailed in the Annex to the draft Act. In addition, the proposed measure aims to withdraw the placing on the market of these substances in respect of the animal species and categories other than those mentioned in the Annex. Transitional periods are laid down for the interested parties to prepare themselves to meet the requirement concerning the new authorisation of the concerned substances and their withdrawal from the market in respect of the animal species and categories other than those mentioned in the Annex.

titlePlain: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/2115 of 23 September 2026 concerning the renewal of the authorisation of menadione sodium bisulphite (vitamin K3) and menadione nicotinamide bisulphite (vitamin K3) as feed additives for all animal species and repealing Implementing Regulation (EU) 2015/2307 (Text with EEA relevance)
descriptionPlain: The substances covered by the Act were authorised for a period of 10 years as feed additives for all animal species in the additive category ‘nutritional additives’ and in the functional group ‘vitamins, pro-vitamins and chemically well-defined substances having a similar effect’. An application was submitted for the renewal of the authorisation of these substances in accordance with article 14 of Regulation (EC) No 1831/2003. Based on the favourable conclusions of a scientific assessment of the dossier submitted by the applicant, conducted by the European Food Safety Authority (EFSA), the authorisation of these substances as feed additives for all animal species is renewed under certain conditions detailed in the Annex to the Act. A transitional period is included for the interested parties to meet the new authorisation’s requirements.

title: Decree amending, supplementing a number of articles of Decree 38/2026/NĐ-CP issued on 24 January 2026 by the Government promulgating import of soil ball plants and production unit codes, packing house codes
description:
The draft Decree amends, supplements a number of articles of Decree 38/2026/NĐ-CP issued on 24 January 2026 by the Government promulgating import of soil ball plants and production unit codes, packing house codes:

i) Ensure the compliance with the ensure constitutionality, legality, consistency, and coherence in the formulation of detailed regulations on granting and management of production unit codes, packing house codes, which are prescribed in Article 64 of the Law on Crop Production 31/2018/QH14 amended, supplemented by Law 146/2025/QH15; 

ii) Ensure the decentralization and authority delegation, practical simplification of administrative procedures, publicity, transparency; no new administrative procedures created, no new components in a dossier created, facilitation for organizations, individuals but fulfillment of the State management requirements;

(iii) Promote application of information technology, deal with administrative procedures in the electronic environment; strengthen decentralization, in close relation with post-examination mechainism and enhanced responsibilities of organizations, individuals during the implementation;

(iv) Ensure compliance with the relevant legislation, match with crop production conditions in Viet Nam, meet requirements of importing countries for export production units, packing houses for, contribute to raising competitiveness of Vietnamese agricultural products; 

(v) Link the simplification of administrative procedures with the enhancement of responsibility for self-declaration, self-acccountability of organizations, individuals to; and, with post-examination, inspection, examination of of the State management agencies, and settlement of untruthful declaration cases or violations. 

 

The draft Decree aims to reduce, simplify administrative procedures, business investment conditions, decentralization, update processes and forms.

title: Draft Order approving the special conditions that regulate equine meat and meat products imported from Mexico intended for human consumption
description: The Draft Order establishes the special conditions that regulate equine meat and meat products intended for human consumption, transposing into national legislation the provisions of Directive (EC) 2006/27, including substance residues, microbiological contaminants, nonconformities regarding certification. The act aims to protect consumer health, ensure a rigorous mechanism for verification of conformities, harmonize the legal framework with European standards, and facilitate international trade.

title: The regulation on inspection and control of Bigeye tuna (Thunnus obesus) originating from fishing activities that are imported, temporarily imported, re-exported and transited through Vietnam by container vessels
description:
The purpose of this corrigendum is to inform WTO Members that a typographical error in Item 6 (Description of content) of document G/SPS/N/VNM/192, circulated on 16 September 2026, has been corrected.

In Item 6 of G/SPS/N/VNM/192, the reference to "Albacore tuna (Thunnus alalunga)" was incorrect. The reference should read "Bigeye tuna (Thunnus obesus)".

This correction is made to rectify the typographical error and does not change the scope or substance of the notified regulation.
